Search expressions can be used to restrict results based upon searchable fields, where the operators can be used along with the suffix wildcard symbol `*`. See [instructions](https://docs.cloud.google.com/agent-registry/search-agents-and-tools) for more details. Allowed operators: `=`, `:`, `NOT`, `AND`, `OR`, and `()`. Searchable fields: | Field | `=` | `:` | `*` | Keyword Search | |--------------------|-----|-----|-----|----------------| | agentId | Yes | Yes | Yes | Included | | name | No | Yes | Yes | Included | | displayName | No | Yes | Yes | Included | | description | No | Yes | No | Included | | skills | No | Yes | No | Included | | skills.id | No | Yes | No | Included | | skills.name | No | Yes | No | Included | | skills.description | No | Yes | No | Included | | skills.tags | No | Yes | No | Included | | skills.examples | No | Yes | No | Included | Examples: * `agentId="urn:agent:projects-123:projects:123:locations:us-central1:reasoningEngines:1234"` to find the agent with the specified agent ID. * `name:important` to find agents whose name contains `important` as a word. * `displayName:works*` to find agents whose display name contains words that start with `works`. * `skills.tags:test` to find agents whose skills tags contain `test`. * `planner OR booking` to find agents whose metadata contains the words `planner` or `booking`.
